description: Classify a contract clause by purpose.

args: Either party may terminate this Agreement with 30 days written notice.
Recipient shall not disclose Confidential Information to third parties.
Customer will pay invoices within 30 days of receipt.
This Agreement is governed by the laws of California.
Provider warrants the services will conform to the documentation.
Neither party will be liable for indirect or consequential damages.
Customer owns all right, title, and interest in Customer Data.
Vendor shall comply with all applicable privacy laws.
The parties are independent contractors and not partners.
Any dispute shall be resolved by binding arbitration.
